notes.title: Trial Interface Overhaul
notes.notes:
To the Crown Mages,

[b]The latest update for Astatos is here![/b] This update brings a major overhaul to the Trial interfaces, improving readability and functionality. Additionally, minor UI tweaks have been made across the entire game along with improvements to the appearance of text. 

[h2]General Trial Changes[/h2][hr][/hr]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41588420/f8ea6934a6c82669ef2c532c15485e051c3e490a.gif[/img]

[b]Several elements of the Tral interface have been revised![/b]
[list][*]The player UI has been redesigned, improving readability, and adding new animations.
[*]The End Turn and Exchange buttons have been redesigned, now appearing more prominent in the UI.
[*]The End Turn button has new animations to guide the player to click it.
[*]The overall layout of interface elements have been adjusted, such as during side selection.[/list]
[h2]Hero Stage Changes[/h2][hr][/hr]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41588420/84f97d05b749033cbab2de187901e995a27bc6e6.gif[/img]

[b]The Hero Stage interface has been revised![/b]
[list][*]Adjusted the appearance and position of the Hero Spaces. New animations have been added when the player and opponent are taking their turns.
[*]Redesigned the Hero Summon button. This button is now much more prominent and intuitive to use. The appearance now indicates if Hero Cards are available to summon. A counter is also shown when you are approaching your Hero Card Summon limit.
[*]Revised the UI elements and spacing of Hero Cards for improved readability.
[*]The Seal Card space has been removed from Takeover Trials where it is not utilised.
[*]Redesigned the Hero Ability interface and animations. The order of animations during Hero Abilities have been changed to make them easier to follow.[/list]
[h2]Trial Stage[/h2][hr][/hr]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41588420/7239248a31d90d3328e4d7e8e627ceb2cdb0a7dc.gif[/img]

[b]The Trial Stage interface has been revised![/b] 
[list][*]A new indicator shows the number of Element Cards that can be matched.
[*]Additional animations have been added when matching the Trial Card.
[*]Hovering an Element Card in your hand highlights the matching Trial Cards in yellow, if any. 
[*]Hovering a Spell Card in your hand highlights relevant Trial Cards in blue, if any.
[*]Spell Card descriptions have new icons indicating if they are played for matching Trial Cards, different Trial Cards, or any Trial Card.[/list]

While some minor Trial interfaces still need to be revised, [b]we hope this update vastly improves the gameplay experience for both new and veteran players![/b]

[h2]Chapter II Progress[/h2][hr][/hr]
Additionally, we’d like to announce that the main scenario text for Astatos Chapter II has been completed! Translation, programming, and illustration tasks are still underway.

[b]For the detailed list of changes implemented with Astatos v0.8, please read on below.[/b]

- From the team at Studio Klondike

[h2]New Content[/h2][hr][/hr][list]
[*]A new Hero Skin has been made available as the monthly reward. The previous month’s Hero Skin has been added to the in-game store.
[*][b]Nikos - The Renewing Blaze[/b][/list]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41588420/2257ea9c72b739d1b47dc014a8bd9ccccfbe6667.png[/img]

[h2]Game Changes[/h2][hr][/hr][list]
[*]Reduced the difficulty of the Story Trial within the sub-chapter “Journey to Irinipolis - Part III”
[*]Updated playable tutorial animations to reflect the UI changes made in this update. (The images for the manual will be updated in a future patch.)
[*]The position of the Takeover Trial and Conquest Trial buttons have been swapped in the Trials menu.[/list]
[h2]Game Improvements [/h2][hr][/hr][list]
[*]Extended the font display system to carry over styles when swapping between languages. In particular this improves the appearance and thickness of shadows beneath text.
[*]Allocated more texture space to the Traditional Chinese and Simplified Chinese fonts, increasing the sharpness of headings.
[*][English only] Improved the text sizing when playing with the Open Dyslexic font enabled.[/list]
[h2]Game Fixes[/h2][hr][/hr][list]
[*]Disabled the high-ping kick when playing the Tutorial or Story Trials. These game modes are hosted locally, as such the server ping check is not necessary.
[*]Resolved a bug that caused some UI to appear semi-transparent during Story Trials.

notes.title: Krokos - The Philosopher's Truth is out now!
notes.notes:
To the Crown Mages,

The latest update for Astatos is here! This update includes this month’s Hero Skin, along with gameplay optimisations and bug fixes.

We’re back from our trips PAX Aus and SXSW Sydney last month. It was great seeing so many new people try out the game and we got to see some fans too! After watching people try the demo version, we have a lot of ideas for improvements to gameplay and UI— some of which are included in this update!

Additionally, while our producer was busy the rest of the team have been working on new CGs and story text for the upcoming Chapter II— with over 15k words of the story being completed this month alone!

[h2]Hero Action Menu[/h2][hr][/hr]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41588420/ccdea3aaccde75103bdc49e2c02d229fd79ecbe9.gif[/img]

We’ve reworked the way players interact with Hero Cards. Upon selecting a Hero Card, a context-sensitive action menu is displayed. This menu allows you to give Energy and toggle Hero Abilities where appropriate.

The Hero Ability description has also been redesigned with better feedback on when Hero Cards can be selected. Hero Ability costs and other information have been moved to the Hero Action Menu.

After watching many players interact with the game at conventions last month, we feel this change is important to make the core mechanics of the Hero Stage intuitive to new players!

Note: With this update, it is no longer possible toggle a Hero Ability by clicking and holding. However, we have left the right-click to toggle functionality in the game as a shortcut.

[b]For the detailed list of changes implemented with Astatos v0.7.15, please read on below.[/b]

- From the team at Studio Klondike

[h2]Game Changes[/h2]
[hr][/hr][list]
[*] The Hero Ability popup has been redesigned to give better information to the player.
[*] The hero action menu now appears when selecting a Hero Card. Some tutorial dialogue has been modified to reflect this change.
[*] Hard AI opponents now perform their actions faster in the Hero Stage.
[*] [Takeover Trial & Story Trial] Hero Cards that cost more than 1 Energy to summon are now summoned with a single action. You can no longer begin to summon these Hero Cards unless you have enough Energy.
[*] Alkaios’ Hero Ability has been revised. Players can now choose to forfeit giving Energy. If all players have run out of Energy or forfeited, the Ability will end automatically.
[/list]

[hr][/hr][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41588420/d1acd90df60772d80c13b279aa65b1377bc252f3.png[/img]
[b]Redesigned Store: [/b]The in-game store has been redesigned from scratch! With the addition of the 31st Hero Skin to the game this month, we found that the previous interface layout was reaching its limit and becoming particularly difficult to search.

The original interface was designed very early in the game’s development, and we didn’t have a solid idea of what kind of content would be included. As such, we’ve wanted to change it for a while now.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41588420/e98698355e16baf2868f977babcc62f04047d215.png[/img]
The store can now display more items at a time, as well as spotlight new skins, and everything is quicker to navigate too. This new redesign extends to the item descriptions, and unlock confirmation pop-ups which now have a consistent look and feel. Hero Skins are now displayed in release order, with the most recently released one shown first.

The store backend is also more flexible— allowing us to easily introduce new item types, extend the designs, and directly navigate the player to a specific category or item.

As this new interface is a big change, please let us know if you run into any bugs or issues!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41588420/071d65c00ca642c50b1143a5845476fbe0348813.png[/img]
[b]Monera Help Pop-Up:[/b] Along with the new store, there’s now a UI to direct players towards ways they can earn Monera. Clicking on each option will automatically navigate you to the relevant menu.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41588420/07af3547dda2b2eec1ac6d5ba3f1bcf53c97fe4d.png[/img]
[b]Hero Skins in Deck:[/b] Unowned Hero Skins can now be previewed and unlocked from the Deck Menu. This means you can easily view all skins available for a given Hero in one place.

Note: Only Hero Skins that are available for purchase in the Store can be previewed.

[/list]

[*] The EXP cap has been increased when playing a Conquest Trial with 5 or more players.
[/list]

[list]

[/list]
[h3]Game Changes[/h3]
[list]
[*] Sound effects have been finalised for Hero Card Drafting.
[*] Sound effects have been finalised for the sticker system.
[*] Improved the handling of multiple sounds playing simultaneously.
[/list]

[*] When creating a new account, the Hero Pack unlock animation would play a second time if you immediately enter the Trials menu and click "yes please" to view the tutorials.
[*] Being invited to a room while in the Deck Menu could cause the incorrect music to play during the Trial.
[*] You can no longer drag the Hero Card list while the artwork viewer is open in the Deck Menu.
[*] Added rollback code, improved stability, and error handling during Hero Drafting.

[b]Hero Card Drafting:[/b] This new feature replaces the Hero Pack Preferences settings in Conquest and Takeover Trials.

Hero Card Drafting determines which additional Heroes show up in the Hero Summon. The drafting process begins in the room prior to the commencement of a Trial.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41588420/3d71b83325ed2c16bd4ac76f4af9c74fb7075bf2.jpg[/img]

[b]Players will be asked to BAN and PICK Hero Cards depending on the game mode.[/b] Banned Hero Cards cannot be picked by any player. 

[b]If you do not own a given Hero,[/b] you will borrow it from another player in the room. [b]If nobody owns a given Hero,[/b] it will not be selectable. (Hero Cards you borrow and do not own will not display Hero Skins.)

We hope Hero Card Drafting will simplify the selection of Hero Cards, as well as open up new combinations and strategies as we prepare for additional Hero Packs to be added to the game. 

Note: Hero Pack Selection remains in place for Training Trials. Additionally, the sound design for this feature is still a work in progress and may be changed in an upcoming patch.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41588420/ed8aa322674d8f77276bc26e8c178604d732f40c.jpg[/img]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41588420/90a3d453559f98036d3a916bcd55c13734a8867f.jpg[/img]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41588420/4c0e70f7164ecbe1474b94e1689778b138358175.jpg[/img]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41588420/865f414c6d145c72acbbe87fcb2d1bbcecd8c232.jpg[/img]

[b]Takeover Trial Leaderboard:[/b] The Rank menu has been expanded to include a Leaderboard allowing you to compare your Rank and ELO values against the top Crown Mages.

Along with this addition, [b]a new Season will occur every 3 months[/b]. With Season I concluding at the end of December.

Upon the conclusion of the current Season, your Rank will be soft reset and the previous Season’s rankings will be finalised. Players within the top 100 will unlock a hidden Title each season.

The Takeover Leaderboard is accessible from: [b]Main Menu > Trials > Takeover Trial > Ranking[/b]

[b]Resolve: [/b]A new gameplay mechanic has been added to Mukaki’s side in Conquest Trials! We look forward to observing feedback on this mechanic and seeing if any further tweaks need to be made.

[b]Resolve[/b] is gained whenever [b]Mukaki's side[/b] activates a [b]Hero Ability[/b]. [b]Resolve points[/b] are displayed along the right side of the screen above the Deck Space. Use your [b]Resolve[/b] in order to keep others on your side!

notes.title: Astatos v0.5 - Revamped Tutorials
notes.notes:
To the Crown Mages,

[b]This update features the next step of the PvE implementation for Astatos.[/b] Over the past few months we’ve been hard at work on a scripting system to introduce single player Trials with custom scenarios to the game.

[b]Included with this update are three interactive Tutorial Trials, aimed at introducing new Crown Mages to the gameplay of Astatos.[/b] We hope this commonly requested feature serves to make the game more approachable to players of all skill levels!

These Tutorial Trials were the test bed used to engineer the scripting tools required for in-game story sequences and scenarios. Along with our A.I. implementation, we’ve managed to run these Trials locally on your computer while making use of our existing multiplayer framework.

[url=www.patreon.com/StudioKlondike][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41588420/0a1a9ea837b0224a4d2fa80c19aac8eac5730174.jpg[/img][/url]

For those curious about the details behind our new single player trials, [b]we released a blog on the subject along with a bunch of concept art and design documents over at our Patreon: [/b]www.patreon.com/StudioKlondike 

[b]As mentioned, this is Part 2 of our PvE updates.[/b] Throughout three updates, we hope to implement the most commonly requested features for the game.

[b]Part 3 will involve the Implementation of Trials into the Astatos story.[/b] In the initial update we hope to cover implementation for the prologue chapter (Ab Initio), then expand to cover Chapter I, and the upcoming Chapter II at a later date.

notes.title: Astatos v0.4 Update
notes.notes:
To the Crown Mages, 

Today we’re pleased to have released the first step in our implementation of PvE for Astatos! In this update you will be able to play single player against A.I. in Trials.

While there’s a few kinks to work out in the A.I. logic itself, the feature represents a big shift in our development of the game—and required nearly as much code as the Trial system itself. You’ll be able to access the PvE from the new Training option in the Trials menu.

As mentioned above, this is Part 1 of the PvE updates planned. Throughout three updates, we hope to implement the most commonly requested features for the game.
[list]
[*] [b]Part 1: [/b]Training Trials where the player can play against A.I. opponents in single player matches. Allowing players to learn the game without the pressure of a real match, and earn daily rewards without the need to rely on other players— albeit at a reduced rate. [b](This patch!)[/b]
[*] [b]Part 2: [/b]Tutorial Trials where the player can learn how to play the game in a structured, and interactive tutorial. This update will involve many of the functions required for Story Trials, such as in-game dialogue, scenario scripting, and fully-local Trials. At this time we’ll look into introducing PvPvE for Conquest as well.
[*] [b]Part 3: [/b]Story Trials: Implementation of Trials into the Astatos’ story. As there will be significant design time involved, we may split this part to only cover implementation for the prologue chapter, then expand to cover chapter 1, and the upcoming chapter 2 at a later date.
[/list]
Please note that the above is subject to change depending on the production schedule for the rest of the game, but we hope you look forward to the changes implemented in this patch, and our future progress for the game!

[b]For the detailed changelog of changes implemented with Astatos v0.4, please read on below.[/b]

- From the team at Studio Klondike

[h1]New Features[/h1]
[hr][/hr]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41588420/f3decff8d5c4b6579eb14f6c134c4ff68ae895f2.png[/img]

[b]Training Trials: [/b]A new PvE mode that allows you to play single player Conquest (4 person) and Takeover Trials against A.I. opponents.

A.I. opponents are available in 5 difficulty settings. Easy, Medium, Hard, Dummy, and Random Actions. [b]When playing against a bot that is “Medium” or “Hard” difficulty, you will receive Monera and Reward Points for the Trial.[/b] You will not however earn EXP in Conquest, or Rank in Takeover Trials.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41588420/80bf03b03d5272f562cd7dc03f94722b9ed9a6c0.png[/img]

Even at the Hard difficulty, you should not expect A.I. to fill in for an experienced human Crown Mage. Rather, it is best to think of this mode as a way to learn the mechanics of the game, or test out new strategies.

Training Trials have their own Hero Pack equip settings that are separate from Conquest and Takeover Trials. Be sure to remember to check these before beginning a Training Trial as this specific setting is not currently saved between game restarts.

This feature is available from the “Training" button in the “Trials” menu. As this option replaces the previous “Tutorials” button that would access the text manual, that button has been moved to the “Training” menu.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41588420/e0dd95b829893ff51e6824856a159ebc2cb9fc0b.png[/img]

[b]Player Discovery: [/b]Within a lobby you will now see the numbers of total rooms, and joinable rooms for that game mode as well as a button to visit our official Discord. A room is joinable when it can be joined via Quick Play. A room is no longer joinable if it is private, or if it is already within a Trial. Players within Training Trials will show as non-joinable rooms. We hope this helps players better find each-other and enjoy the game in conjunction with the PvE features implemented in this patch.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41588420/712591431944bf4582d0b1cf52e5b95427d11e59.png[/img]

[b]Spell Card Names: [/b]After some UI adjustments, Spell Cards have now been given proper names in Trials. The name changes are as follows:
[list]
[*] Spell A -> Altered Trial
[*] Spell B -> Blessed Trial
[*] Spell C -> Consecrate
[*] Spell D -> Divine Favour
[*] Spell E -> Exalted Element
[/list]
We hope this change serves to make spell cards more recognisable, especially if more Spell Cards are added to the game in future updates.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41588420/281217494e4fc6d93862149696463d3fec45b762.png[/img]

[b]Ping: [/b]Your ping is now visible from the pause menu during a Trial. We recommend playing Astatos with a ping below 300ms. If your ping exceeds a certain threshold, you may be forcibly disconnected from a Trial.

notes.title: Astatos v0.2 Update
notes.notes:
To the Crown Mages,

A new update to Astatos is here! Due to some of the system-level changes introduced in this update all players will need to download the new version to continue playing.

With this update we added new story content to Chapter 1, a new game mechanic has been introduced into Trials, and several quality of life fixes have been implemented. Along with these changes we have focused on revising our codebase, fixing bugs in Trials, and otherwise improving the stability of the game.

With this patch out of the way we will start to work on the following for future updates.
[list]
[*] [Short Term] Improve the gameplay experience during Trials, particularly with a goal to improve game-length issues with only “Base Gods and Heroes” equipped.
[*] [Short Term] Continue to work on bugs, Hero balancing, and quality of life changes.
[*] [Long Term] Continue to work on offline Trials and AI matches, including an interactive tutorial.
[*] [Long Term] Revise Chapter 1 of the story with new character sprites and new scenes.
[*] [Long Term] Implement Chapter 2 of the story along with single player Trial gameplay.
[/list]
[b]For more details about the new features and detailed changelog of changes implemented with Astatos v0.2, please read on below.[/b]

- From the team at Studio Klondike

[h1]New Story Content[/h1]
[hr][/hr]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41588420/b277dcf6b60dec979a766d293cd8a7f2e875824a.png[/img]

Seven new scenes are available in the Interlude menu. These scenes take place and unlock throughout Chapter 1 of the story. Scenes are available for the following characters: Sulpicius, Cerkles, Makari-Hari, Zermes, Mukaki, Herclaus, Reece.

[b]Note: Some Interlude scenes will only become available after seeing previous corresponding Interlude scenes in "Ab Initio”.[/b]

[hr][/hr]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41588420/57086e3a9e5fb13137eda378470689b6de9febcd.png[/img]

[b]Hero Ability Cooldown:[/b] After using a Hero Ability, that Hero will go into Cooldown for 1 Round. During the Cooldown you will be unable to activate that Hero and use their Ability. During a Cooldown you can still give Energy to your own, and your opponent’s Heroes. If a Hero flips sides, their Cooldown will be reset immediately. Heroes with Passive Abilities don’t have an Ability Cooldown.

By introducing the Hero Ability Cooldown we hope to increase variety in matches and open up new avenues for strategic planning by preventing players from repeatedly using the same Hero. We’ll be monitoring feedback to this change and making other changes as appropriate.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41588420/54d03b84d5b0a78eba950183f588e3e01571e9f4.png[/img]

[b]Befriend Your Opponents: [/b]You can now send friend requests to other players on the victory screen. If both players send a friend request, the request will automatically be accepted.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41588420/6875878658815888ee56b3733398cbd1fbb35f72.png[/img]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41588420/097c567fa8d8274d521542d2fdd14044d3d54e6b.png[/img]

[b]Skip Mode: [/b]The Skip function allows you to quickly advance through dialogue in Story scenes. By default, you can only skip scenes that you have seen and completed before on any one of your Save Slots.

You can enable Skip by holding down the [s] key.

[b]Note: Due to changes in the story save file format, some scenes will not be considered as “seen” until you view them again with the v0.2 version of the game.[/b]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41588420/0fdfb9275af5c39d434a10e097a8b8c3015aa15b.png[/img]

[b]Auto Advance:[/b] The Auto function allows you to advance dialogue automatically in Story scenes. The speed that dialogue advances can be changed in the settings menu.

You can toggle Auto by pressing the [a] key.

[*] [System] The way Cards are drawn and discarded has been consolidated and revised to be more reliable, improving the stability of any action or Hero Ability related to Cards.
[*] [System] Players are no longer able to receive more than the maximum of 20 Cards in their hand.
[*] [System] Card element trackers on the player icons have had several desync issues resolved and show now be accurate in displaying what elements that player currently has in their hand.
[*] [System] Hitting End Turn at 0 seconds left in the timer during the Trial Stage or the Hero Stage had the chance that both the end-turn button and the timer would try to send data to the server at the same time. This would result in the game proceeding incorrectly.
[*] [System] Under circumstances where the game becomes desynchronised between players, each player could decide a different side goes first in the Hero Stage. This is no longer possible even under similar circumstances.
[*] [Hero] Gaining a Spell Card using Sulpicius’ Passive Ability did not trigger Aristotle’s Passive Ability.
[*] [Hero] Gaining a Spell Card during Zermes’ Ability while Aristotle’s Passive Ability is active can no longer result in errors.

[*] [Conquest Hero] The card distribution screen after Aklaios’ Ability could fail to load and soft-lock the Trial.
[*] [Conquest Hero] If Drusus and another Hero were activated in the same turn on Mukaki's side, there was a chance that no players would remain on Mukaki's side at the end of Drusus' Ability. In this case the next Hero would incorrectly activate their Ability and soft-lock the match.

[*] [Conquest Trial] With precise timing you could submit a card in a 0.5 second period after the Trial Stage had completed, failing the Trial Stage, but also receiving 1 Energy for passing the Trial Stage afterwards
[*] [Conquest Trial] Varius would only let you select yourself rather than all the players on your side when distributing Energy as the Consul.
[*] [Traditional & Simplified Chinese] Timaio’s Ability description in Takeover Trials did not properly reflect his Ability.

[h2]Interface Fixes[/h2]

[*] Fixed an issue where level-up reward Monera could be displayed as a separate item on the Victory screen if you had already reached your daily Monera cap.

[/list]

[*] When the Room Owner leaves a hosted room, the new Room Owner will now correctly be transferred the room controls and be able to invite players or start the game.

notes.title: Astatos v0.1.4 Update
notes.notes:
To the Crown Mages,

Today we have updated the version of Astatos to 0.1.4. This update was pushed due to some time-sensitive changes needing to be made to the server to improve it's stability.

As a result of this update being release a little suddenly, some changes to the game are currently a work in progress. Over the past week, we've been working on a clean-up and refactor to the code for Trials to provide us a nicer codebase to continue working on. As a part of this, thousand of lines of code have been modified.

Due to this, you may find both fixes to areas such as the Trial Stage; as well as new bugs in other places as we continue to work through the codebase. We aim to resolve any issues as they are reported, but also ask for some more time to get everything in tip-top shape!

- From the team at Studio Klondike

[h1]Changelog[/h1]
[h3]General[/h3]
[list]
[*] Updated some server code as we continue to work on improving server uptime.
[*] Decreased the amount of time a player takes to disconnect when their internet connection cuts out from 60 seconds to 20 seconds.
[*] Added a limit to the maximum amount of Rank you can lose after losing a battle in a Takeover Trial.
[*] Fixed an issue resulting in the incorrect amount of Monera being awarded upon level up after a Conquest Trial.
[*] Updated the Simplified Chinese font to include missing characters from the story mode.
[*] Fixed some typos in the User Manual.
[*] Heroes will no longer display the incorrect amount of Energy required to summon them in the Hero Summon Menu.
[/list]
[h3]Work in Progress[/h3]
[list]
[*] Trial Stage code refactor. Card sending and refunds should now be more predictable. More fixes to come.
[*] Hero Stage code refactor. The general code for the Hero Stage has been revised, with the code for each Hero Ability remaining a work in progress.
[/list]
[h3]Balance[/h3]
[list]
[*] The Hero, Lysander now costs +1 Energy to summon in both Conquest and Takeover Trials.
[/list]
[h3]Known Issues[/h3]
[list]
[*] [strike]The Hero Ability for Krokos does not work properly on Makari-Hari's side. We hope to get this fixed within the next 24 hours.[/strike] This issue has now been fixed. If you previously downloaded the v0.1.4 patch, you may need to download the latest version by restarting Steam.
[*] [strike]The Hero Ability for Makari-Hari did not work correctly in Conquest Trials[/strike]. This issue has now been fixed. If you previously downloaded the v0.1.4 patch, you may need to download the latest version by restarting Steam.
[*] [strike]The Hero Ability for Varius did not work correctly.[/strike] This issue has now been fixed. If you previously downloaded the v0.1.4 patch, you may need to download the latest version by restarting Steam.
[/list]

notes.title: Astatos 0.1.3 Update
notes.notes:
To the Crown Mages,

We're back from the holidays with a new patch! This patch contains some small new content, as well as a bunch of bug fixes.

To begin with, the Trials portion of the User Manual has been re-written from scratch with the goal of improving the experience of new players learning the game. Additionally, over 70 images have been added to the manual to visually illustrate each entry. This was something that got left on the cutting room floor for the release earlier this month, so we're super glad to get this improvement into the game.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41588420/7798557dea4f00d893d17a1f7c7b9b77d1a1ced9.png[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41588420/4cdf547a659ec1b8d51caf302c2fe5007e3ad1fc.png[/img]

The chapter "In A Sweet And Fitting Way" is now available in Traditional and Simplified Chinese. Previously, this chapter was only available in English.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41588420/ce2e5fae6201cb4f35378d6bb4b96da9cce71ec8.png[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41588420/66508ad3b33cedeb89e20a5a26b431bf21a9b307.png[/img]

Additionally, several bugs related to Takeover and Conquest Trials have been resolved. In particular, relating to the Heroes Alkaios, and Drusus. Be sure to see the full changelog below for details.

And that's all for today! We're going to get back to work on fixing up Trial bugs, so be sure to keep on reporting them to us over in our Discord, it's a massive help!

- From the team at Studio Klondike

[h1]Changelog[/h1]
[h3]Key Changes[/h3]
[list]
[*] The user manual has been revised! The gameplay portions of the manual have been rewritten to help better convey the game mechanics. Over 70 images have been added to the manual to visually illustrate each entry.
[*] Various bug fixes to Conquest and Takeover Trials.
[*] Various new sound effects have been added.
[/list]
[h3]Trial Fixes[/h3]
[list]
[*] Hovering over a Hero Card quickly will no longer result in the Hero Ability tooltip being stuck on screen.
[*] Hovering over the "End Turn" button during a Trial when a Spell Card is used to change the Trial Card/s will should longer result in the button becoming un-clickable.
[*] Hero Energy submitted in the Hero Summon menu will no longer be refunded twice during the Hero Stage if the Energy was submitted during the first turn.
[*] Alkaios will no longer soft-lock a Conquest Trial when the Card distribution menu is displayed.
[*] Spamming the submit Energy button on the Alkaios wager interface will no longer submit more Energy than you possess.
[*] Drusus now correctly tracks failing to pass his Ability's Trial Stages in Takeover mode, preventing previously frequent desync issues.
[*] Drusus now correctly tracks the use of Spell Cards during his Trials in Conquest and Takeover trials, preventing previously frequent desync issues.
[*] Rank loss will now be correctly calculated by the game client. Previously Rank loss was displayed, but never tracked. This meant that players would see an incorrect Rank which could only increase until they restarted the game and received the correct value from the server.
[*] Regulus and Timaios now display the correct text for their abilities.
[*] Resolved an issue that would cause the Trial to start with 8 cards being drawn before soft-locking.
[/list]
[h3]Story Content[/h3]
[list]
[*] [b]The chapter "In A Sweet And Fitting Way" is now available in Traditional and Simplified Chinese.[/b]
[*] A new animation has been added to the "system" text in the sub-chapter "Prologue".
[/list]
[h3]Story Fixes[/h3]
[list]
[*] Fixed a decision in the sub-chapter "To Ashes" which would lead to an incorrect scene being displayed.
[*] Fixed a decision in the sub-chapter "The Devil's Son" which would lead to an incorrect scene being displayed.
[/list]
[h3]Game Fixes[/h3]
[list]
[*] Levels will now be correctly tracked on your progress towards unlocking related Titles.
[*] Achievements and Titles related to playing Conquest and Takeover Trials should now all track the correct game modes
[/list]
[h3]Known Issues[/h3]
While we're working hard to wrap up the remaining bugs in multiplayer trials, the following are issues that are known or carried over from the previous patch.
[list]
[*] Un-Summoning Sulpicius by using Nikos when your side is at the Hero Summon Limit will incorrectly keep Sulpicius' passive ability active.
[*] Some text may display incorrectly in Traditional and Simplified Chinese until the font is updated to include new characters added by this update.
[*] Heroes will sometimes display an incorrect summon cost In the Hero Summon menu. The actual Energy cost to summon said Hero should still be correct regardless of what is displayed on the interface.
[/list]

notes.title: Astatos 0.1.2 Update
notes.notes:
To the Crown Mages,

Today we have one last update before we'll be taking a short break for the holidays. It contains a few fixes for surrounding the removal of passives from players, along with balance tweaks for Heroes in Takeover and Conquest Trials.

[b]These changes include an update to how failing the Trial works in Takeover. Instead of losing Energy first, you will get to keep your Energy and instead you will lose Influence.[/b] This change is not currently documented in the manual, but we'll aim to get that out next week along with a larger update to the manual to make the game easier to learn. (Including images!)

We are aware of desync issues, and some conditions where Hero abilities will cause the Trial to stop continuing. We are still working hard to resolve these, but need some more time to catch them all.

This update also sends us more robust debugging information when you give us feedback. So if you run into any issues, be sure to hit the feedback button in the pause menu and send us details of what happened. (In particular what Heroes were used would be a massive help!)

We hope you enjoy your time playing Astatos!

- From the team at Studio Klondike

[h1]Changelog[/h1]
[h3]Gameplay Adjustments[/h3]
[list]
[*]Failing the Trial Stage in a Takeover Trial will no longer remove Energy from players. Instead players will lose 1 Influence. If both players fail the Trial Stage, no one will lose Influence.
[/list]
[h3]Hero Balancing[/h3]
[list]
[*][Takeover] Mukaki has a new One Time Ability. [b](Once per game) Lose one influence, then swap all the Cards in your hand with those held by your opponent.[/b]
[*][Takeover & Conquest] [b]Aristotle's ability will now activate only once per round.[/b] (The new round beginning with the Trial Stage)
[*][Takeover & Conquest] Lysander's ability has been updated. [b]Pick an Element, then a player. All matching Cards in their hand are converted into Energy.[/b]
[/list]
[h3]Trial Fixes[/h3]
[list]
[*] Nikos will correctly remove Passive Abilities when he flips Heroes to their side. Additionally, passives will be correctly removed when one side already has 7 Heroes and the additional Hero is un-summoned and sent back to the Summon Menu. (Please note: There is a known bug where un-summoning Sulpicius will result in the next turn to break. We will aim to hotfix this in the near future.) 
[*]Varius can now correctly remove Energy from Heroes with Passive Abilities.
[*]Drusus will no longer stop the match from progressing when letting the timer run out, or when failing the second of his Trial Stages.
[/list]
[h3]Game Improvements[/h3]
[list]
[*]Feedback given by players will now send us the full debugging log to help us track down errors.
[*]When Makari-Hari or Mukaki have used their once per match Ability, their card borders will darken slightly to let everyone know the Ability has been used.
[*]Improved data loading. The deck, profile icon selection menu, and loading into Trials have each had their loading code reworked. This should help prevent unexpected hang-up's in these areas. In addition, a short loading screen has been added prior to opening the Deck Customisation menu.
[/list]

notes.title: Astatos 0.1.1 Update
notes.notes:
To the Crown Mages,

Since last week we've been pushing out several updates as we continue to work on bug fixes and improvements to the game. Over this time we've resolved a significant amount of bugs related to the menus, story mode, progression, and overall game functionality. We can't thank our players enough for discussing these issues and helping us discover the causes.

As a part of this update progression, has been fixed as Monera should be given to players upon levelling up. [b]To repay the lost rewards to players who didn't receive their level up rewards during this time, as well as thank everyone for playing the game while we get things in order, we will be increasing the Daily Reward to 250 Monera for the next 14 days.[/b]

Additionally, several issues relating to the game when played in Traditional and Simplified Chinese have been resolved. While some issues still persist, we hope our players in these languages will find the game much better than launch day.

[b]From here on out, we'll be working on improving the stability of multiplayer. We hear you loud and clear about requested balance fixes, and we'll be looking out for small tweaks we can make — but our priority right now is to ensure a smooth gameplay experience.[/b]

Thank you all for playing, and we hope to make the game even better from here on out.

- From the team at Studio Klondike

[*] The Hero summon animation upon signing up now displays the correct artwork.

[*] Kyros now shows your opponent's hand as intended in Conquest and Takeover Trials.
[*] Improvements to the UI for the Trial Stage to prevent locking up when more than 5 Trial Cards are displayed.

[*] Fixed an incorrect sprite in the sub-chapter "Spicae".

notes.title: Astatos v0.1 Hotfixes
notes.notes:
To the Crown Mages,

With the release of Astatos into Early Access, we've been hard at work over the past day fixing a bunch of bugs to make sure everyone has as smooth of an experience as possible. We made sure to prioritise bugs that prevented people from playing the game, and are keeping an eye out on remaining issues.

Thank you all so much for your amazing help in the Steam Community and the [url=http://discord.gg/nekojishi]SK Discord[/url] which enabled us to tackle so many issues this fast. We've been gathering your feedback and will continue to look into issues over the next few days to prepare a full update patch.

We are also finishing the scripting on 7 additional Interlude topics for Chapter 1 which are also planned to release next week. We hope players will look forward to them!

- From the team at Studio Klondike
